codeReview.summary: The Runs migration delivers the requested React functionality end-to-end: status/agent/source filtering, 10/25/50 page sizing, Prev/Next pagination meta, deep-linkable run detail, payload JSON viewer, model steps, timeline-based tool inspection, collapsed repeated-failure groups, and loading/error states, with matching scoped Playwright coverage. One non-blocking edge-case was identified in pagination metadata synchronization.

issues.description: The list response shape includes `limit`/`offset`, but `loadRuns` only updates `runs` and `total`; `currentPageStart/currentPageEnd` are computed from local `offset`. If backend pagination clamps offset (for example after data shrink), the UI meta can drift (e.g., stale `offset` with new `total`).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker skill still mixes two validation expectations: it instructs running the full dashboard e2e suite and manual verification, but also includes a migration note directing scoped specs due known unrelated failures. This makes `followedProcedure` interpretation inconsistent across migrations.
